milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because light_blue_terracotta drops itself when mined with a pickaxe, so the mined item ends up in the player's inventory. The player starts with zero light_blue_terracotta (verified via /clear command returning 'No items found') and is given an iron pickaxe. After successfully mining at least one block from the 3x3x3 cube placed at spawn-relative (3,0,3) to (5,2,5), the player will have at least 1 light_blue_terracotta in inventory.
